The questions give B18 as the shares cell, but B18 holds cash. Shares outstanding is 'Input sheet'!B21, so I used that for q6.

Changing shares changes the cost of capital through market-cap weights in the 'Cost of capital worksheet'. Everything downstream of the cost of capital moves with it. I found the affected cells by recalculating the workbook in LibreOffice with shares 10% higher and comparing against a baseline recalculation.

I didn't recalculate q1 and q2 independently. They match the workbook's stored values.

The q6 list includes the 'Option value' cells that depend on the share count. They change even though options are switched off, because B30 on the valuation sheet doesn't read them.
